adjudication.rationale: `EmbeddableHost` allows mixed-case values to be persisted (`validates_format_of ... /i` and the `before_validation` only strips scheme/path, it does not downcase). But `record_for_host` queries with `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` without downcasing the bind parameter, so if `uri.host` ever contains uppercase characters (e.g. from a mixed-case URL/referer), the comparison becomes `lower(db_value) = 'Example.COM'` and will not match in a case-sensitive DB. Using `lower(host) = lower(?)` or passing `host.downcase` would avoid this mismatch.
